title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
grouping: Two halves, each starting with the same blue speech bubble 'I spilled my drink, can you help?'. Left half: three rows, each a pale-blue rounded box with a bold grey model name (GPT3, LaMDA, FLAN) and a grey speech bubble with that model's unhelpful reply. Right half: a dashed grey rounded container holding three speech bubbles - blue 'LLM' and pink 'Value Functions' on top, their tails pointing down into a 'SayCan' bubble below - and outside it a grey speech bubble with the numbered plan '1. find a sponge ... 5. done'.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded speech bubbles with tails, no outlines. Inside the LLM and Value Functions bubbles the same candidate skills ('find a cleaner', 'find a sponge', 'go to the trash can', ...) are listed in italic with font size set by score, so each source's favourite is the largest line; the combined bubble shows 'find a sponge' largest and bold. Small robot photos are inset in the Value Functions bubble and beside the SayCan bubble.
proposed_highlight: The method's name is split in two colours - 'Say' in the LLM blue, 'Can' in the value-function red - and its bubble is filled with a blue-to-pink gradient, so the combination is written into the name and fill; the dashed container groups the method against the plain model rows on the left.
lesson: Encode each candidate skill's score by its font size inside the speech bubbles, and blend the LLM bubble's blue and the value-function bubble's red into the combined bubble and the two halves of the method's name.
notes: Venue CoRL from Semantic Scholar (title match, venue_source: semantic-scholar); year 2022 = S2 year and arXiv year. elements 'other' = speech bubbles. Annotation note (2026-11-15): teaser comparison rather than a method pipeline; useful for score fusion by colour, not for module layout.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: grounding LLM plans in robot affordances

core.what: inside a dashed frame a blue LLM bubble and a red Value Functions bubble both point into one SayCan bubble whose fill blends blue into red, each listing the same candidate skills with font size giving that source's score

relations.form: left: GPT3, LaMDA and FLAN as three stacked blue boxes, each with a grey speech-bubble answer; right: SayCan under the same 'I spilled my drink' prompt bubble, ending in a grey bubble with a numbered plan
LLM (top left) and Value Functions (top right, with a robot photo) bubbles taper down into the SayCan bubble below them, whose list re-ranks the candidates ('find a sponge' largest)
the SayCan bubble, a robot photo, and the grey answer bubble listing 'find a sponge ... done' read left to right

channels.colour: blue = language model (LLM bubble, 'Say', prior LLM boxes), red = value functions/affordance ('Can'), blue-to-red gradient = their combination; grey = model answers
channels.shape: speech bubbles = utterances and scored candidate lists, rounded boxes = prior models, photos = robot and scene
channels.line: no connecting lines; bubble tails point to the source or target
channels.frame: a grey dashed frame encloses the SayCan system

quality.strengths: the combination is drawn rather than named: two colour-coded sources taper into one bubble that blends their colours, and the candidate lists show the scores by font size so the re-ranking is visible; the same prompt heads both halves, setting prior answers against SayCan's plan
quality.weaknesses: font size as score is unkeyed and the lowest-scored candidates are too small to read; the prior LLMs get a third of the width only to show failure; the robot photos are small and their role is not labelled

insights.structure: Two halves each headed by the same blue speech bubble; the left half stacks three rows of model-name box plus reply bubble (GPT3, LaMDA, FLAN), the right half holds a dashed rounded container with LLM and Value Functions bubbles above a combined SayCan bubble and a numbered plan bubble outside.
insights.data: Candidate skills are quoted italic phrases inside speech bubbles whose font size encodes each skill's score, with small robot photos inset in the Value Functions and SayCan bubbles.
insights.emphasis: The name is split 'Say' in LLM blue and 'Can' in value-function red, and the SayCan bubble fill is a blue-to-pink gradient, so the combination is shown by colour alone.
insights.flow: Reading is left to right from the baselines to the method; inside the container the two scorer bubbles' tails point down into the SayCan bubble, which points right to the plan.
insights.avoid: The smallest scored phrases are illegibly tiny, so the size encoding is visible but the low-scoring text cannot be read.

arrangement.units: two unframed halves (baselines, method) side by side; the method half's core is enclosed in a dashed grey rounded container
arrangement.inputs_as: a blue speech bubble with the quoted user request, repeated over each half
arrangement.shared: the same user request bubble heads both halves
